issues.problem: Context reply 「それは疑心暗鬼だよ。」 is a stiff, unnatural way to tell someone they are being paranoid.
issues.action: Rewrote as 「それは疑心暗鬼になってるだけだよ。」, the form people actually say.

issues.problem: Story checked: the lost-axe tale (『列子』説符) and the phrase taken from a later commentary on it are as traditionally told; the source names no commentator, which keeps it safe.
Story checked against 『孟子』離婁上 (自暴者不可與有言也，自棄者不可與有為也…): accurate.
Context 6 「一攫千金の近道などない」 is an awkward collocation.
issues.action: Rewrote as 「一攫千金を狙うより、地道に働くほうが確実だ。」

issues.problem: The cue described disasters already happening on opening day, which calls for 四苦八苦 (struggling now) just as much as for troubles still to come.
issues.action: Rewrote the cue so the café has not opened yet and the troubles all lie ahead.

issues.problem: The how line left out 前途洋々たる, the standard written attributive form.
issues.action: Added たる to the how line. The contexts keep な / の / だ, which the format allows.
